items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Yeah, do you know him? Yeah, he used to sing and, you know, play, Tone of Bandra, play guitar. I learned about play. You know, he can play a little, but he couldn't play much on Tone of Bandra.

ctx.x: He said, what about Albert French? Yeah, do you know him? Yeah, he used to sing and, you know, play, Tone of Bandra, play guitar. I learned about play. You know, he can play a little, but he couldn't play much on Tone of Bandra. And I learned to him, oh, what do you know about Tone of Bandra? But I didn't learn how to play guitar.
